critical_code_review_comments: attachments.py is clean: MongoDB ObjectId never leaked (uses BaseDocument.to_mongo/from_mongo + str(inserted_id)); size/mime validation is applied both at sign-upload and again on PUT content (defence-in-depth); soft-delete is enforced by status filter in list, view_url and (matched_count==0) on second delete.

signing module properly used with distinct 'upload' / 'view' purposes and TTLs (UPLOAD_TTL=15m, VIEW_TTL=1h); PUT content path is not behind Firebase auth (correct: it uses signed URL); DELETE is behind Firebase auth with owner_id match.
auth.py uses google-auth id_token.verify_firebase_token with audience=FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID; run_in_threadpool wraps the sync call — correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is behind Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' + 429 rate-limiting; MUST pace navigations by ≥45–60s between page.goto()s, avoid wait_until='networkidle' (Vite HMR keeps a WS open — always times out), use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_selector on a specific testID. Firebase user session persists via IndexedDB across the same browser context, so login once per test run. All new testIDs required by Phase 2/4 exist in the codebase — do NOT patch them, only exercise them. Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_attachments.py (pytest .ini already discovers it) — run `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -v` for fast (~2s) full backend check.
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — this was a first-iteration verification of Phase 0/1/2/4 features. All backend endpoints behave as specified; frontend testIDs are in place; the only limitation is external (Cloudflare rate-limit on the shared preview domain) which prevented deep live exercise of the review flow within a single testing budget.
